verdict.rationale: Metorial documents first-party hosted MCP endpoints. Magic MCP servers expose a provider's tools through one connection, sessions return a `connection_url` for any MCP client, and portals let users copy a standard MCP URL into clients like Cursor, ChatGPT, and Claude. An Agents area also shows which clients connected. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent client to the Metorial MCP endpoint (the probes only verify docs and the REST API).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: A Magic MCP server gives you a hosted MCP endpoint for a provider. Metorial manages the server and makes the provider's tools available through one connection.
Returns a `connection_url` you can connect an MCP client to
Users enter a portal to connect approved integrations, discover shared skills, and copy a standard MCP URL for their AI client.
Let your team connect AI agents and MCP clients like Cursor, ChatGPT, and Claude to approved apps, tools, and shared skills, with access controls and activity logs.
The Agents area shows which agent clients have connected to Workforce and what they have done.
